name: react-loop
description: ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) loop implementation for AI agents. Runs Thought → Action → Observation cycles with tool dispatch, message history tracking, and configurable max iterations.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to implement the ReAct agent pattern: the LLM reasons about what to do (Thought), calls a tool (Action), observes the result (Observation), and repeats until it produces a Final Answer. Register tools with addTool() and provide an LLM call function.

parameters.name: maxIterations
parameters.description: Maximum number of Thought/Action/Observation cycles before halting. Default: 10.

parameters.name: onStep
parameters.description: Optional callback invoked after each loop step with the step details.
